title: Tagg3d Cosmetics Pack
description: Adds textures to some cosmetics on the hit minecraft server Tagg3d.
body:
This texture pack adds hats, foods/drinks, different held items and a costco membership card.
Can be used outside of Tagg3d but it doesn't add much. We would appreciate it if you used this texture pack while playing Tagg3d for a better experience.
Does include weapon(s).
